cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved replacing the sink. That dripping tap has exposed an opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we just fit this washer? I've already bought it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Washer use is approved once the sink is out. Then we can replace the swollen worktop properly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Removal of the cupboards is authorized. You may start emptying them; with the kitchen bare, we can finally correct the whole layout.

reason: Make approval of B small repair conditional on a wider project, then use the actual worktop dependency to authorize a still more disruptive layout change.
